mapper.select: SELECT id, datasource_id, user_code, sql_text, sql_type, status, affected_rows, cost_ms, error_message, create_time FROM dbview_sql_history WHERE deleted = 0 AND datasource_id = #{datasourceId} AND user_code = #{userCode} AND sql_type = #{sqlType} AND status = #{status} AND sql_text LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') AND create_time >= #{timeFrom} AND create_time <= #{timeTo} ORDER BY id DESC
